title: [29.x]Incorrect Purchase Credit Memo created when Customer and Vendor Subscription Contracts have the same Contract Number.
summary: Fixed incorrect purchase credit memo creation when customer and vendor subscription contracts share the same contract number by filtering billing totals by partner in addition to contract number.
key_points: Billing total calculations now filter by both subscription contract number and partner
Prevents customer contract credit memo lines from affecting vendor contract invoice type
Addresses issue where shared contract numbers caused wrong document type generation
Changes made in BillingLine and BillingProposal objects
quote: The billing total that decides between an invoice and a credit memo filtered only by Subscription Contract No.
